test_date.desc: date the pulmonary function test was performed, at the precision stated

fev1_liters.desc: FEV1 after bronchodilator when post-bronchodilator is reported, otherwise the stated FEV1

fev1_percent_predicted.desc: post-bronchodilator FEV1 percent predicted when available

fvc_liters.desc: FVC after bronchodilator when post-bronchodilator is reported, otherwise the stated FVC

fvc_percent_predicted.desc: post-bronchodilator FVC percent predicted when available

dlco_percent_predicted.desc: DLCO percent predicted, if a readable result is stated

bronchodilator_response.desc: whether a significant bronchodilator response is stated

interpretation_pattern.desc: obstructive, restrictive, mixed, or normal pattern as the interpreter stated it

interpretation_severity.desc: severity grade as the interpreter stated it

home_oxygen.desc: home oxygen use or consideration as stated

current_chest_pain.desc: what the note says about chest pain

family_emphysema.desc: what the note says about emphysema in a family member

primary_pulmonary_diagnosis.desc: primary pulmonary diagnosis in the clinician's own words, without copying a billing code as the value

smoking_cessation_date.desc: smoking cessation date at the precision stated
